content.thinking: This looks like a duplicate report, so I'll note that it's worsening and reply to the tenant—a constant drip isn't an emergency flood, so I can keep to the normal routine. I'll mention the isolation valve option and send a message back to them.

arguments.note: 10/10 tenant emailed: tap now drips constantly even when fully closed, getting worse. Duplicate of this job, no new ticket. Visit 15/10 08:00-12:00 stands. Contractor to be told of worsening.

arguments.body: Hi Amelia, thanks for letting us know. Your tap is already booked under job R-4801, with Swift Plumbing & Heating on Thursday 15 October, 8am-12pm. We haven't opened a second job, but we've added a note that it's getting worse so the plumber knows. In the meantime, a bowl under the drip helps, and you can turn off the small valve under the sink if it gets worse. If water starts to leak elsewhere or spreads, please let us know straight away. We'll update you if anything changes before the visit.
